q: What is the convention for making outbound HTTP calls from the gateway?

results.text: axios is forbidden in this codebase; outbound HTTP goes through the platform fetch wrapper with a 2-attempt retry budget.
The protocol buffer schema lives at proto/gateway.proto.
The gateway's default listen port is 8787.
The gateway must never log full request bodies in production; pino structured logging with redacted fields is the convention.
The feature-flags service endpoint is http://flags.internal:7070.
The admin API is mounted under /_admin and requires the internal bearer token.
The feature-flags service endpoint is http://flags.corp:7071 after the service mesh migration.
Continuous integration runs in GitHub Actions on the self-hosted buildkite pool.
The p99 latency budget for the gateway is 250 milliseconds.
Per-client rate-limit counters live in Redis with a 60-second TTL.
